Question ID: Q006
Question: What is the average capacity in MW for each asset type?
raw_response:
1. ```sql
SELECT
  at.asset_type_id,
  AVG(a.capacity_mw) AS average_capacity_mw
FROM assets AS a
JOIN asset_types AS at
  ON a.asset_type_id = at.asset_type_id
GROUP BY at.asset_type_id
ORDER BY at.asset_type_id;
```

2. ```sql
SELECT
  at.asset_type_id,
  ROUND(AVG(a.capacity_mw), 2) AS average_capacity_mw
FROM assets AS a
JOIN asset_types AS at
  ON a.asset_type_id = at.asset_type_id
GROUP BY at.asset_type_id
ORDER BY average_capacity_mw DESC, at.asset_type_id;
```

3. ```sql
SELECT
  at.asset_type_id,
  AVG(CASE WHEN a.capacity_mw IS NOT NULL THEN a.capacity_mw END) AS average_capacity_mw
FROM asset_types AS at
LEFT JOIN assets AS a
  ON a.asset_type_id = at.asset_type_id
GROUP BY at.asset_type_id
ORDER BY at.asset_type_id;
```
